title: DamageDoctor CarDD YOLO
subtitle: CarDD in YOLO format — 6 damage classes
description:
Private training dataset for the DamageDoctor project. CarDD only, in YOLO format: 2816 train / 810 val / 374 test images. This is the same CarDD-only dataset used for the production v1 detector weights.

Classes: 0=dent, 1=scratch, 2=crack, 3=glass shatter, 4=lamp broken, 5=tire flat.

Converted locally from CarDD COCO format with `python src/convert_coco_to_yolo.py` before upload.
